eventDescription:
Vidhaigal , Golden Hearts Lion Club, and Othivakkam Panchayat jointly organized a grand tree planting ceremony, which was celebrated with great distinction.
500 fruit-bearing trees ? including mango, jackfruit, guava, jamun, lemon, custard apple, sapota, and gooseberry ? were planted during the event.
The core message of this event was the awareness that planting fruit trees is essential to protect the livelihood of birds and to restore the balance of nature.
The most remarkable and exemplary moment of the ceremony was when the village elders stepped forward, took on the responsibility of "five trees per person", and pledged to nurture and protect those trees themselves.
